prompt: Hi Zara, it's Tariq at the dog park. Your golden retriever just jumped into the duck pond five minutes after leaving the grooming salon! Sorry, can you ___ (speak / talk) up? The ducks are making so much noise.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол speak up означает «говорить громче».

prompt: Hello, I'm calling the city hotline about the park drinking fountain. Strictly ___ (speak / talk), it's meant for drinking, not showering, yet it shoots water sideways onto passing joggers whenever anyone presses the button.
explanation_ru: Вводное выражение strictly speaking («строго говоря») используется только с глаголом speak.

prompt: Grandma, I've got flour up to my elbows and my thick lentil soup tastes way too salty! Can you ___ (speak / talk) me through an emergency fix before my friends arrive?
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение talk someone through something означает «подробно объяснить кому-то что-то шаг за шагом».

prompt: Hello, Officer, someone borrowed my bright orange garden gnome overnight and left a polite seaside postcard in its place—it's gone on holiday, so to ___ (speak / talk).
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение so to speak («так сказать») всегда употребляется с глаголом speak.

prompt: Hi Sam, my old red tractor just stopped right beside the sheep gate and it's blocking the milk delivery truck. I'm trying to ___ (speak / talk) the driver into waiting an hour, so could you come out right away?
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk someone into doing something («уговорить кого-то сделать что-то») используется только с глаголом talk.

prompt: Victor called Elena from the paint section and said, "Please ___ (speak / talk) me through the difference between cream and eggshell, because there are twelve shades of plain white on this shelf."
explanation_ru: В выражении talk someone through something (подробно объяснить кому-то что-то шаг за шагом) используется только глагол talk.

prompt: When the downtown textile seller answered the phone, Olga said, "Hello, this is Olga from the theatre ___ (speak / talk). Our lead actor ripped his cloak on a chair, and I need three metres of dark green velvet by four."
explanation_ru: В телефонной формуле представления «This is [имя] speaking» используется только форма speaking.

prompt: Marta tried to ___ (speak / talk) the rushed caller out of booking a terrace table for eight on the windiest evening of the month.
explanation_ru: Во фразовом глаголе talk someone out of something (отговорить кого-то от чего-то) используется только глагол talk.

prompt: Because the street was noisy five minutes before the surprise dinner, Amir had to ___ (speak / talk) up so Diego could hear that he was at the wrong sister restaurant across the river.
explanation_ru: Во фразовом глаголе speak up (говорить громче) используется только глагол speak.

prompt: Luis was relieved that the eye clinic receptionist could ___ (speak / talk) Spanish, which made it much easier to move his Tuesday glasses check-up to Thursday ahead of the snowstorm.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идёт о владении языком (speak Spanish), всегда используется глагол speak.

prompt: While repairing his grandfather's barn roof, Henrik found a wooden box of hundred-year-old postcards tucked behind a loose beam. He immediately phoned the archive and asked to ___ (speak / talk) to the head archivist. Once connected, they ___ (speak / talk) about the condition of the cards for twenty minutes. The archivist added that a colleague who can ___ (speak / talk) German would help translate the oldest notes.
explanation_ru: В телефонном обращении обычно используется speak to (допустимо talk to), для обсуждения темы — talked about (допустимо spoke about), а с названиями языков — только speak.

prompt: At midnight, Samir noticed his bedside lamp flickering whenever the neighbour closed the bathroom door. He dialled the front desk, and the night clerk answered, "Reception, Nadia ___ (speak / talk)." Samir explained the issue and ___ (speak / talk) briefly to the maintenance worker who arrived two minutes later with a spare bulb. They did not ___ (speak / talk) for long because the new bulb fixed the flicker right away.
explanation_ru: В телефонном приветствии используется только speaking; в остальных случаях в значении «поговорить» возможны оба глагола (spoke/talked, talk/speak).

prompt: Salma was walking down the avenue when she got an unexpected callback for a morning interview. Because a street sweeper was passing right behind her, she had to ask the caller to ___ (speak / talk) up. She quickly ducked into a quiet doorway so they could ___ (speak / talk) about the office address without background noise. Before hanging up, the caller thanked her for ___ (speak / talk) so clearly.
explanation_ru: Во фразовом глаголе speak up (говорить громче) используется только speak; с предлогом about чаще выбирают talk, а для манеры речи (clearly) — speaking.

prompt: Piotr unwrapped the glass frame and saw it was two centimetres too narrow for a nineteenth-century botanical drawing needed for tomorrow's opening. He rang the local framer at once and asked, "Could I ___ (speak / talk) to Tomasz about an urgent order?" When Tomasz came on the line, Piotr ___ (speak / talk) him through the exact measurements. Tomasz promised to cut a new frame that evening.
explanation_ru: В вежливом телефонном вопросе «Could I speak to...» стандартен глагол speak (разговорно допустим talk), а в выражении talk someone through something используется только talk.

prompt: Thirty minutes before the orchestra tuned up, Filip opened his suitcase at the coat check and found two left black dress shoes. He called home in mild panic and ___ (speak / talk) so fast that his sister could barely understand him. She told him to take a deep breath and ___ (speak / talk) slowly while she searched for the matching right shoe. Ten minutes later, she arrived at the hall just in time.
explanation_ru: Для описания темпа речи (fast, slowly) естественны оба глагола: speak чаще подчёркивает саму манеру произнесения, а talk — процесс общения.

prompt: The school secretary called David at work and asked to (speak / talk) to him urgently. She needed to (speak / talk) about his nine-year-old son, who arrived wearing a raincoat and carrying a bag of apples instead of his sports kit. David sighed and promised to (speak / talk) with the boy as soon as he got home.
explanation_ru: В телефонном разговоре для просьбы соединить обычно используют speak to, а для обсуждения темы и беседы с кем-то — talk about и talk with (speak также допустимо).

prompt: Mateo called the workshop below to ___ to the chief engineer about the freezing dome shutter.
explanation_ru: С предлогом to в значении «поговорить с кем-то» используется глагол speak (speak to someone).

prompt: Max called customer support to ___ about the uneven legs on his new coffee table, and the agent promised a replacement before Friday.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения обсуждения темы без прямого дополнения используется глагол talk с предлогом about (talk about something).

prompt: Owen tried to ___ to his sleepy goalkeeper ten minutes before kickoff, because the player had forgotten the match was moved to Saturday morning.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk употребляется с предлогом to перед адресатом (talk to someone), тогда как tell и ask требуют прямого дополнения без предлога.

prompt: Lucas phoned his broadband provider to ___ with a technician about his Wi-Fi dropping whenever the kitchen microwave turned on.
explanation_ru: С предлогом with перед собеседником используется глагол speak (speak with someone).

prompt: Henrik had to speak the breakdown operator very loudly because of the wind noise near the petrol pump.
answer: Henrik had to speak to the breakdown operator very loudly because of the wind noise near the petrol pump.
accepted_answers: Henrik had to speak to the breakdown operator very loudly because of the wind noise near the petrol pump.
Henrik had to speak with the breakdown operator very loudly because of the wind noise near the petrol pump.
Henrik had to talk to the breakdown operator very loudly because of the wind noise near the petrol pump.
Henrik had to talk with the breakdown operator very loudly because of the wind noise near the petrol pump.
explanation_ru: После глагола speak перед адресатом необходим предлог to или with (speak to / speak with someone).

prompt: Omar called the lost-luggage hotline to talk about the suitcase with a smiling banana sticker on it.
answer: Omar called the lost-luggage hotline to talk about the suitcase with a smiling banana sticker on it.
accepted_answers: Omar called the lost-luggage hotline to talk about the suitcase with a smiling banana sticker on it.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: сочетание talk about (поговорить о чём-то) употреблено грамматически верно.

prompt: Lucas talked his sister quietly on his mobile to get the exam room number from a photo he had sent her.
answer: Lucas talked to his sister quietly on his mobile to get the exam room number from a photo he had sent her.
accepted_answers: Lucas talked to his sister quietly on his mobile to get the exam room number from a photo he had sent her.
Lucas talked with his sister quietly on his mobile to get the exam room number from a photo he had sent her.
Lucas spoke to his sister quietly on his mobile to get the exam room number from a photo he had sent her.
Lucas spoke with his sister quietly on his mobile to get the exam room number from a photo he had sent her.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk не используется без предлога перед собеседником: нужно говорить talk to или talk with.

prompt: Lucas does not know Japanese well, so he uses a pocket phrasebook to ask the gardener for the name of the tall purple tree. Which sentence is correct?
options: Lucas cannot talk Japanese, so he used a pocket phrasebook with the gardener.
Lucas cannot speak Japanese, so he used a pocket phrasebook with the gardener.
Lucas cannot say Japanese, so he used a pocket phrasebook with the gardener.
Lucas cannot tell Japanese, so he used a pocket phrasebook with the gardener.
explanation_ru: С названиями иностранных языков всегда используется глагол speak (speak Japanese).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using the verb 'speak' instead of 'had a conversation': Victor had a conversation with the supplier about the double-charged paper order while the fire alarm beeped.
answer: Victor spoke with the supplier about the double-charged paper order while the fire alarm beeped.
accepted_answers: Victor spoke with the supplier about the double-charged paper order while the fire alarm beeped.
Victor spoke to the supplier about the double-charged paper order while the fire alarm beeped.
explanation_ru: В прошедшем времени глагол speak имеет форму spoke и употребляется с предлогом with или to (spoke with / spoke to).
